notes.title: Maid Cafe Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the official release date for upcoming adult game Maid Cafe... You can look forward to playing the game in full on the 25th August 2023. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/3fe6184f9887899da32c04fb0feb4f501d8f5dc5.png

Make sure you wishlist the game now to be notified on release, so that you can enjoy the biggest game we have published. Maid Games have done an amazing job with the development of this game.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/28b5f5aa9e28f131d54905c498d548df9af977b9.png

It features almost half a million words of dialogue and scripting, over 35 characters to meet and have sexy fun with, plus over 1000 adult illustrations to unlock and enjoy, plus the chance to explore the town, buy items from shops, visit local destinations, go on dates, practice your desserts, learn new recipes and compete in a bake off competition!

Wishlist it now and don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423640/Maid_Cafe/

Deluxe Bundles and Discounts available on release, the game also comes with trading cards and Achievements to unlock.

notes.title: Easier Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Today we posted a new update for the game for version 1.3.

After receiving a variety of feedback and requests, we have adjusted the games difficulty settings, to make it easier to unlock some of the more difficult endings, removing some of the choice requirements and allowing for more freedom to make mistakes, we hope this will make it easier for our players to enjoy the game to it's fullest extent and unlock the extra endings.

In addition this update also features an upgrade to the games framework, that should resolve some issues people are having with achievements and with the latest version of OSX Sierra.

Finally we have also fixed a few lingering text errors within the game.

-
p.s. A new forum named 'bugs' has been added to the discussion hub, if you find other bugs or errors please post them there and we will look into them.

notes.title: Release Date - November 17th
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the release of Magi Trials has been moved forward to November 17th.

Highschool Romance: Magi Trials is a brand new title, created by the same team who worked on Highschool Romance, our aim was to create a new story, with a new cast of characters in a new setting whilst retaining similar themes and style to the original, with a larger budget offering us the opportunity to build a larger story, with more artwork and events to explore and unlock.

This new story tells a brand new tale this time set in a school of magic, to add to the crazy shenanigans and ecchi encounters for players to enjoy. Whilst they make decisions throughout the game affecting the ultimate conclusion of the story.
